summary: Deprecated single-value tween. Use Animate To Value (net.noodl.animatetovalue) in new graphs.
description: The legacy Transition node tweens `currentValue` toward `targetValue` with duration/delay/easing — the same contract Animate To Value now provides, plus an override-current-value pair for jumping mid-flight. Deprecated and hidden from the picker.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use net.noodl.animatetovalue instead.
